title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: When the weather turns
hook: It starts raining ten minutes into practice.
intro: Now the field is getting wet.
statement: A weather plan saves a dozen text messages.
q1: Do you set clear weather rules at the start of the season —
q2: or decide on the day based on conditions?
q3: Who decides, and how do families find out?
t1: Both can work. But families stay calm
t2: when they know how weather calls get made.
cta: Coaches — what is your weather plan?
ctaLines: Lightning means stop. A text by 4 pm. Play in light rain.
Set rules or call it on the day?
ctaPrompt: Share your weather habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
It starts raining ten minutes into practice.
The forecast said maybe. Now the field is getting wet.
A weather plan saves a dozen text messages.
Set rules early or decide on the day. There is no perfect answer.
What is your weather plan? Share your habit in the comments.
